subject.title: [security] Diagnostic redaction leaves common OAuth and cloud JSON secret fields visible

question: Should Crabbox expand the documented diagnostic JSON-field redaction taxonomy to cover OAuth refresh/ID tokens and cloud/API secret aliases in both redactors now?
rationale: This is a credential-diagnostics boundary change, so maintainers should confirm the exact field taxonomy even though the implementation shape is narrow.

options.title: Patch both redactors
options.body: Add the reported aliases to a shared or mirrored taxonomy with Go and Worker regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow the docs boundary
options.body: Treat these aliases as outside the current guarantee and update the security documentation accordingly.

options.title: Defer for live exploit proof
options.body: Wait for an end-to-end provider diagnostic sample before changing redaction behavior.

recommendation.title: Patch both redactors
recommendation.body: Add the reported aliases to a shared or mirrored taxonomy with Go and Worker regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest merged diagnostic-redaction hardening and are the clearest routing owner for the current regex taxonomy.
